usercmd_s.unk09 (0x09) and the playerState fields at 0x4c, 0xd0, 0xdc and 0xa0 bits 2/3 are named by usage only; their gameplay meaning and the full playerState_s size are open.

Whether MSG_WriteDeltaStruct's print flag selects a debug trace in the shipping build, or whether the MSG_WriteDeltaPlayerstate print=1 is a release-visible trace, is inferred from the code and not from a string.
MSG_BitCount (0x08067c3e), UserCmd_MoveClass and UserCmd_MoveFromClass have no identifying string or caller in this chunk; their names are descriptive only.
